lines.text: Long sled made the caverns in your record. I said we keep that mouth off city maps. Doesn't mean I'm the only one who knows the turn.
Listening stake's in. Record says hum comes up from below the sensor. Handy direction, down. Not much of a distance marker for a sled.
Your account gives Ute's viewpoints, no name for the light. She offers the views. I wouldn't pack a sled for a road that record doesn't show.
Named piece back. Log gives a window before Directorate arrival. I'll race anyone; I'd still like to know who's timing the other sled.
Recovery record says where. Named salvage, not whatever fits on your sled. That's the road.
Wall-folk. Read the recovery card. We'll race when the work calls for it. Loser carries.
Wall-folk on a sled. Sit down, hold on, don't touch the brake.
